resources.string: Ana iya samun damar shiga kwamfutarka a cikin LAN ta sunan ta ko adireshin IP.
Yi amfani da takaddun shaidar da aka sa hannu da kai da aka samar ta atomatik
Kalmar wucewa ta takaddun shaidar (idan ana buƙata)
Zaɓi babban fayil ɗin don raba ga mai amfani %1$s
Da fatan za a zaɓi fayil ɗin takaddun shaidar.
Da fatan za a ƙara mai amfani ɗaya aƙalla.
Mai amfani %1$s yana da bayanan da ba su cika ba.
Kuskure wajen dakatar da uwar garke: %1$s
(iri ɗaya da batun — an sanya hannu kai tsaye)

Wannan uwar garken yana amfani da takardar shaida da aka sanya hannu kai tsaye. Abokan ciniki na FTP na iya nuna gargaɗi na tsaro yayin haɗi. Idan an tambaye ku, kwatanta sawun yatsa da aka nuna a abokin ciniki ɗinku da ƙimar da ke ƙasa kafin yarda.
Don haɗawa, na\'urar abokin ciniki dole tana cikin hanyar sadarwa ɗaya da wannan waya (Wi-Fi ɗaya, ko hotspot / USB tethering ɗaya).
Don haɗawa, na\'urar abokin ciniki dole tana cikin hanyar sadarwa ɗaya da wannan kwamfuta (Wi-Fi ko LAN ɗaya).

Shigar da kowane abokin ciniki na FTPS, misali:
 • Windows: WinSCP, FileZilla
 • Linux: FileZilla, lftp
 • macOS: Cyberduck, FileZilla
 • Android: Ghost Commander
 • ko wani abokin ciniki da ke goyon bayan explicit FTPS
Cika filayen abokin ciniki kamar haka.

Host shine adireshin na'urar da FTPS Server ke gudana.
Gwada adireshin IP. Sunan na'ura yana aiki kawai idan hanyar sadarwa za ta iya warware shi.

Yi amfani da ɗaya daga ciki:
Port shine tashar aikace-aikacen a wannan host.

FTPS Server yana ɓoye umarni da bayanai.
Yana goyon bayan EXPLICIT TLS kawai (AUTH TLS / FTP over TLS).

A cikin abokin ciniki, zaɓa:

 Protocol: FTP
 Encryption: Explicit TLS
 (FileZilla: "Require explicit FTP over TLS"
 WinSCP: "TLS/SSL Explicit encryption"
 Cyberduck: "FTP-SSL (Explicit AUTH TLS)")

Kada ka zaɓi Implicit FTPS (sau da yawa ana kiran sa "FTPS" kawai) — ba zai haɗa ba.
Waɗannan asusu ne da za su iya shiga foldocin da aka raba.
Wannan uwar garken tana amfani da takardar shaida ta kansa. Abokin ciniki zai yi gargaɗi.\nKwatanta fingerprint ɗin abokin ciniki da ƙimar da ke ƙasa. Idan sun dace, karɓi takardar shaida.
Idan abokin ciniki ya nuna \"Fingerprint\" kawai (babu sunan algorithm), fara da SHA-256, sa\'an nan SHA-1.
